papers.title: Comparison and evolution of Ti6Al4V bioalloy fabricated by laser and electron beam additive manufacturing: Mechanical features and anisotropic electrochemical properties
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Materials Engineering, Isfahan University of Technology, Isfahan 84156-83111, Iran

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Materials Engineering, Isfahan University of Technology, Isfahan 84156-83111, Iran

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了Ti-6Al-4V合金的增材制造机械性能，与用户关注的核心方向完全吻合。
llm.why_not_core: Does not explicitly focus on fatigue behavior, which is a key aspect of the direction's interest.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较激光与电子束增材制造Ti6Al4V合金的机械与电化学各向异性性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验表征两种工艺制备样品的力学性能和电化学行为。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了不同工艺下机械性能的差异及各向异性特征。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试（如拉伸、硬度）和电化学测量验证结果。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the mechanical and anisotropic electrochemical properties of Ti6Al4V alloy fabricated by laser and electron beam additive manufacturing.
summary_en.method: Experimental characterization of mechanical features (tensile, hardness) and electrochemical behavior for samples from both processes.
summary_en.result: Differences in mechanical performance and corrosion resistance were observed between laser and electron beam fabricated Ti6Al4V.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (tensile, hardness) and electrochemical measurements were used to validate the findings.

papers.title: Numerical simulation and experimental characterization of a single-seam plasma wire arc additive manufacturing process for Ti-6Al-4V
papers.abstract: Arc welding processes are increasingly being used in the additive manufacturing of metal components. Physics-based modeling of welding processes enables the study of welding parameter effects on the final weld shape, residual stress state, and distortion, helping to improve weld quality and reduce costs. However, the quality of the process simulation strongly depends on the mathematical description of the heat source. The parameters of the heat source model have a significant influence on the temperature field and, consequently, on the distortion and residual stress fields. This paper presents a trial-and-error method for determining the parameters for Goldak&rsquo;s double-ellipsoidal heat source model. The transient temperature distribution and the size of the melt pool are determined through experimental studies. Numerical models are then set up in Simufact Welding 8.0 with a set of heat source parameters to reproduce the experimental trials. By comparing numerical finite element results with experimental results, the heat source parameters for a multi-pass additive manufacturing process are successfully calibrated and identified.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文针对Ti-6Al-4V的等离子丝材电弧增材制造过程进行热源参数标定和热场模拟，虽未直接报告力学性能，但残余应力与热历程对疲劳性能有间接影响，可为后续力学建模提供基础。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on process simulation and heat source calibration rather than mechanical or fatigue characterization of Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 校准等离子丝材电弧增材制造热源参数以准确预测温度场和残余应力
summary_zh.method: 采用Goldak双椭球热源模型，结合试错法在Simufact Welding中校准参数
summary_zh.result: 成功标定了多道增材制造的热源参数，模拟结果与实验吻合
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量熔池尺寸和温度分布验证数值模型

summary_en.motivation: To calibrate heat source parameters for accurate thermal and residual stress prediction in plasma wire arc additive manufacturing of Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: A trial-and-error method is employed with Goldak's double-ellipsoidal heat source model in Simufact Welding to match experimental temperature and melt pool geometry.
summary_en.result: The calibrated heat source parameters successfully reproduce the thermal history and melt pool size for multi-pass deposition.
summary_en.validation: Numerical results are validated against experimental thermocouple measurements and melt pool dimensions.

papers.title: Welding of thick Ti-6Al-4V plate via narrow gap oscillating laser tungsten inert gas (NG-OL-TIG) hybrid welding: microstructure and mechanical properties

corresponding_authors.name: Gang Ruan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Marine Equipment, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, 200240, China

papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究焊接工艺而非增材制造，不符合L1方向的要求。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on welding of Ti-6Al-4V plates, not additive manufacturing, so it does not address the core focus on additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V mechanical/fatigue performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究厚Ti-6Al-4V板的焊接工艺，但非增材制造。
summary_zh.method: 采用窄间隙振荡激光钨极氩弧焊（NG-OL-TIG）进行焊接。
summary_zh.result: 分析了焊接接头的显微组织和力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸和硬度测试验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the welding of thick Ti-6Al-4V plates using a hybrid welding technique.
summary_en.method: Narrow gap oscillating laser tungsten inert gas (NG-OL-TIG) hybrid welding was employed.
summary_en.result: Microstructure and mechanical properties of the welded joint were characterized.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing including tensile and microhardness tests was conducted.
